description: Look up a code in a published code list. list (required) is one of: cds-procedure-codes-imports and cds-procedure-codes-exports (HMRC CDS requested and previous procedure codes, DE 1/10, e.g. 4000, 1040); cds-additional-procedure-codes-imports and cds-additional-procedure-codes-exports (HMRC CDS additional procedure codes, DE 1/11, e.g. C07, 1RV). With code it returns the code's name as published, the heading it is listed under, its status and the list's edition; with q it searches that one list (exact code, code prefix, then name); with neither, the list itself, paged. Use it to read what a UK customs procedure or additional procedure code means; for a commodity code use hs_code_lookup, for UK duty uk_duty_calculator. Codes and names as HMRC publishes them on GOV.UK (Open Government Licence v3.0, attribution in every answer). No completion rules and no declaration check; reference, not advice. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

code.description: One code, as published (e.g. 4000, C07). Leave out to search or to list.

full.description: Full rows (heading and edition on each) instead of summary rows, five per page by default.

include_deprecated.description: Also list and search codes the publisher marks as no longer to be used (a direct lookup always returns them, with the status). No list served today marks one.

limit.description: Page size: summary rows 1-200 (default 50), full rows 1-25 (default 5).

list.description: The code list, e.g. cds-procedure-codes-imports (the lists are named in the description). Required: a lookup or a search runs within one list.

offset.description: Page start for a list or a search (default 0).

q.description: Search within the list: exact code first, then codes starting with q, then names containing it.

name: code_list_lookup
title: Code List Lookup
